{{Weapon infobox | type = Trident | prefix = selectable | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | uslot = Superior Sigil of Venom | bound = account use | skin = Kraitkin (skin); Venom (skin); Warden Trident (skin); Venom Experiment (skin) | id = 30701 | gallery1 = Kraitkin.jpg | gallery2 = Kraitkin drawn.jpg | gallery2-text = Drawn effect. | gallery3 = Kraitkin concept art.jpg | gallery3-text = Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]]. }} [[Kraitkin]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] trident crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|"I've studied the [[krait]] for some time, but never have I seen anything else quite like that. One of their shamans performed a ritual on one of their dead—undeniably dead—and it was living once again!"}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Venom (weapon) | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Kraitkin | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Fortune | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Mastery }} == Graphics == [[Kraitkin]] is a [[krait]] inspired trident with multiple moving eel heads that spray green bubbles, and small fish dart and twirl around the trident. The trident itself has a light-green trail effect. This effect comes from the green bubbles that are continuously being sprayed from the mouths of the eels. ; Aura * The user is surrounded by bubbles and scales, which also leave a trail while moving. ; Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, a burst of bubbles will appear, as well as a red aura that changes to blue and emanates from the user's body. * The eels on the trident move and spray out green bubbles when their mouths open. * There are two currents of water around the shaft which flow up towards the head of the trident. ; Skill effects *Kraitkin does not have any unique projectile or skill effects, making it unique among legendary weapons. == Full material list == {| {{STDT|crafting}} |- ! [[Attribute combinations|prefixes]] can be selected: {{prefix selection|all legendary}} == Trivia == [[File:Kraitkin night.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Original (bugged) appearance at night.]] * Kraitkin was originally thought to have a different appearance at [[day and night|night]], as the eels would become petrified and emit a faint but noticeable light-green glow, along with an aura of bubbles that would appear around the whole trident. This was eventually removed, and later confirmed to be a bug.[https://www.reddit.com/r/Guildwars2/comments/6jzrh3/legendary_weapon_kraitkins_effects_have_been/djj0r65/ /r/Guildwars2 | Comment by mattp] == See also == * [[Kraitkin I: The Experimental Trident]] * [[Kraitkin II: The Perfected Trident]] * [[Kraitkin III: Venom]] == References == {{Legendary weapon nav}} [[de:Kraitkin]] [[es:Kraitkin]] [[fr:Sandekrait]]
